test_title: PYST 9 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

The country has at least twenty colleges __**of whom only six are officially recognized.**__

options.text: of whom only six are officially recognized
of whom only six have been officially recognized
of which only six has official recognition
Of which only six are officially recognized

solution:
The correct answer is '**Of which only six are officially recognized**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**of which**" is used to refer to things or objects (colleges in this case), making Option 4 grammatically correct.
 
• The original sentence uses "**of whom**," which is used for people and is therefore incorrect here.
